Publish.LongDescription:
# Arabic Street Names
**Arabic road and district names on the map, drawn the way they are written.**
The game draws road and district names on the map with a text renderer that does not support Arabic: letters come out separated and in reverse order. This mod fixes it.
## Features - **Connected letters**: initial, medial, final and isolated forms, plus the lam-alef ligatures. - **Right-to-left order**, with numbers and Latin words kept left to right inside Arabic names, and mirrored brackets. - Works for **road names and district names**, including custom names you type. - Uses the game's own fonts when they have the Arabic letter forms, otherwise a Windows font. - Only the map labels change: names in menus and panels are untouched (the game's interface already handles Arabic).
## Options - On / off. - Keep or drop diacritics (dropped by default: the label renderer cannot place them precisely over letters). - Word spacing (default 10%). - Arabic letter size (default 60%). - Fallback font: Auto / Arial / Tahoma / Segoe UI / None, with a font status line.
## Compatibility and safety - Patches only the two calls that pass a name to the map label renderer, using Harmony 2.3.3 (0Harmony.dll included; compatible with mods built on Harmony 2.2 and 2.3). - Nothing is saved into your city; safe to remove at any time.
## Support
**If you enjoy the mod and would like to support me:** [PayPal](https://paypal.me/MeshaalFayez). And don't forget to rate the mod here and star it on GitHub.
